note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of 23.11.2026. No judgment, tribunal order or writ with a party named Plant Essentials Private Limited was found — so court_cases is null (no case identified), with the caveat that Indian Kanoon does not index all district courts, NCLT admission orders or consumer forums. (3) Registry lookups failed: ZaubaCorp returned HTTP 403, Tofler returned 404 for the guessed URL slug, InstaFinancials returned HTTP 403, and a direct Google query returned HTTP 429. No CIN, PAN, incorporation date, directors or registered state could be confirmed, and none are invented here. credit rating: null — no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite action found or searchable; absence of a rating is normal for a small private limited company and is not a negative signal. news_risk: null — no negative news, regulator action (FSSAI, GST, SEBI, RBI, ED, DRI) or enforcement item identified, but this reflects search failure rather than a verified clean record. rf_supply: null — no evidence found of supplies to Russia or the CIS; equally, no evidence of absence could be established, since Russian import records (FTS/customs), UN Comtrade mirror data and B/L aggregators were not reachable. Per project rules, sanctions, court cases and criminal matters are never rejection grounds — nothing here would justify rejection on those grounds regardless of outcome. IMPORTANT CAVEAT FOR THE VERDICT OWNER: this record is materially under-researched. The declared HS 220299 (non-alcoholic beverages, e.g. plant-based drinks) is consistent with the name 'Plant Essentials', but HS and legal identity are outside this role's scope and were not checked. Recommend re-running this company once the search backend is restored, and cross-checking the exact registered name against MCA/ZaubaCorp and the OFAC/EU/UK consolidated lists by hand before any decision.
